name: Long Trip To Your Mom's
source:
Your parents divorced when you were a kid. Your  sister stayed with your mother, and your brother and you went with your father to another city, a few dozen hours away.  15 years later, your sister sent you and your brother a message inviting you to live with them.

Your Brother refused to go, but you couldn't miss this meeting. And now you're going on a Long trip to your mom's.

[From Patreon]
translation:
小时候，父母离婚了。妹妹留在母亲身边，你和哥哥则跟着父亲，搬去了相隔数十小时路程的另一座城市。15年后，妹妹给你与哥哥发来消息，邀请你们搬去和她们同住。

哥哥拒绝前往，你却不愿错过这次重聚。于是，你踏上了前往母亲家的漫长旅途。

[摘自Patreon]
